tasks.title: Align _md_rows default float format with show()
tasks.detail: _md_rows defaults to .3g while _pcpkg.show defaults to _auto_floatfmt(df). Make the annex default match the render default so a rebuilt row grounds. Verify 1476/1476 still ground before touching any anchor.

tasks.title: Carry the column header: schema_ext.SourceReference.table_header
tasks.detail: Subclass SourceReference in schema_ext.py (never edit annex_contract/), re-export it, add table_header. row_quotes() returns rows that know their header; ref() gains table_header=. Dump with serialize_as_any=True (pydantic drops subclass fields silently otherwise). check_grounding verifies table_header verbatim. Record in COMMON_EXT / schema_extensions_used.

tasks.title: Re-anchor PCP/PCR-004 (harvest) and PCR-003 PARs
tasks.detail: h_params/h_cqas/h_pars on rendered rows (plan_params .0f for PCP-004, report_params, cqas_by_keys in the .qmd's key order). Also fix build_proven_acceptable_ranges (bioreactor) to anchor on D.par_table rows.

tasks.title: Tighten the reuse rule to 3 for prose spans
tasks.detail: specificity_report: prose reuse > 3 is a weak anchor; a rendered row (contains CELL_SEP) keeps the wider cap, because a row carries both ends of its relation by construction. Then drive the residue to zero by re-anchoring, never by raising the number.
